Let the agent send SMS for you?

While auto-reply is on, AgentPhone reads new text messages and sends a reply automatically after the delay. The reply is written by your AI provider, which may cost tokens. Shortcodes, verification codes and suspicious messages are skipped, your own number is never answered, the timer stops as soon as you reply, and a daily limit applies. Every send appears in Agent activity and as a notification.

Your own account, through the official TDLib library

AgentPhone uses your own Telegram account through TDLib, not a bot. Telegram does not officially support third-party clients built this way and may limit or ban an account that behaves like automation. You supply your own api_id and api_hash from my.telegram.org; this app never ships or shares credentials. Away mode sends like a person: it waits, types, stays within small daily limits and never bulk-sends. You are responsible for following Telegram\'s terms. Keep away mode off if you are unsure.
Create an application at my.telegram.org, then copy its api_id and api_hash. They are stored encrypted on this phone only.

When away mode is on, AgentPhone keeps Telegram connected and answers allowed chats after the delay.

The agent will read unanswered Telegram messages and may send replies as you. It uses your AI provider with no tools, escalates anything sensitive, respects daily limits, and adds an auto-reply note where enabled. Message text goes only to your configured AI provider. I am not available right now. Leave a message and I will reply personally as soon as I can. If it is urgent, say so. Never make promises about payments, meetings or firm commitments, and never share private data or codes.

For reliable away mode: allow AgentPhone to run in the background, remove it from battery restrictions, and enable autostart if your phone has one (Xiaomi/HyperOS, Samsung, Huawei, Oppo, Vivo, Asus).
